messages:
aisha: Heads-up 1: customer HarborFin sent LoRA merge (adapter_hf_v1). Quick smoke shows inconsistent handling of invoice IDs and trailing zeros in amounts. can we triage?
tom: can you attach the merge diff and the golden prompts?
aisha: diff applied to models/harborfin/adapter_hf_v1, alpha=0.38. eval pack: https://redwood.dev/evals/harborfin-invoice-quick-2026
leah: did a tokenizer id and vocab sanity: ids match. noticed token boundary splitting on amounts like '120.00' -> ['120', '.', '00'] vs baseline sometimes merging.
omar: kicked off 4 quick runs: (1) fp16 base + fp16 lora, (2) int4 base + fp16 lora, (3) int4 base + int4 lora, (4) fp16 base + int4 lora. command: ```bash
./bin/quick_eval --model harborfin:adapter_hf_v1 --quant PROFILE --prompts invoices_golden.json --out /tmp/harborfin.json
```
leah: include a kvcache warmup variant; we saw boundary drift with cold cache before.
omar: run summaries: (1) fp16/fp16: id-exact 99.5%, amounts exact 99.6% PASS. (2) int4 base + fp16 lora: id-exact 98.0%, amounts 96.8% FAIL (dropped trailing zeros). (3) int4/int4: id 96.5% amounts 95.2% FAIL. (4) fp16 base + int4 lora: 99.0%/98.8% borderline.
aisha: warming kvcache (10 queries) improved (2) to 98.9% amounts but still below our 99.0% bar.
leah: hypothesis: quantized base kernels shift logits at decimal token boundary; LoRA in fp16 mitigates but int4 base still causes mis-tokenizations (or token-prob shifts) on '.' and trailing zeros.
tom: propose experimental mitigations: (a) recommend float16 base for invoice routes, (b) enable kv_warmup=10 for serving, (c) add post-processing sanitizer for numeric tokens (align trailing zeros) as temporary fix, (d) add auto-fallback to fp16 when numeric SLO fails.
aisha: agreed. i'll add a note to the model catalog: "harborfin-adapter_hf_v1: prefer base=float16 for financial/invoice routes; kv_warmup=10; numeric_sanitizer=true (temporary)"
omar: i'll add a smoketest gate in CI: run invoice golden set across quant profiles on every adapter merge and block if amounts exact-match < 99.0%.
smoke-bot: Job 93422 started on pool-dedicated-04. logs: https://redwood.dev/jobs/93422
leah: follow-up action: we should run an isolation test (float16 base + int4 base weights loaded as a separate blob) to confirm whether kernel selection or quant rounding is culprit. tagging @omar to schedule.
aisha: thanks team 1: will hold rollout until catalog metadata and smoketest gate are in place. :thumbsup:
